growthFormula: Growth = PO value (Oct 2025–Sep 2026) ÷ PO value (Oct 2024–Sep 2025) − 1, per country × product, on de-duplicated customers (golden IDs). PO value in SGD for cross-product totals; PO units within a product.
measureNote: Confirmed customer POs only (PRs, enquiries, follow-ups and MDM requests are not volume). PO value in SGD at fixed illustrative FX for cross-product totals; PO units within a product. We compare the same 12 months a year apart, never half-years, so dengue season, fiscal-year flushes and CNY/Tet do not show up as growth.
cleaningNote: Merging duplicate customers alone does not change country × product totals: the group's 12-month PO value is S$53.4M in both views (raw 53,441,989 vs de-duplicated 53,441,989). Only two things move value between cells: misattribution (S$1.1M of MY and VN hospitals' POs booked to SG-coded duplicate records from Jan 2026) and miscategorisation (S$350k of reagent test kits coded as Product B, mostly in TH). Cells changed by cleaning carry a Δ badge: SG·A, SG·B, MY·A, MY·B, TH·A, TH·B, VN·A, VN·B, MM·A, MM·B. The de-duplicated view uses the synthetic data's ground-truth golden IDs; the matcher that would build them in production is scored separately on held-out countries.
